newsitem.title: FINLAND: UPM-KYMMENE CUTS POHJOLAN VOIMA STAKE.
newsitem.headline: UPM-KYMMENE CUTS POHJOLAN VOIMA STAKE.

text.p: Finnish forest industry group UPM-Kymmene Oy said in a statement on Monday it will sell 1.5 million shares in power group Pohjolan Voima Oy to insurer Ilmarinen for about 500 million markka.
"UPM-Kymmene will sell 1,500,000 series C (thermal power) shares in Pohjolan Voima to Ilmarinen Pension Insurance Company," it said.
UPM-Kymmene's ownership stake in Pohjolan Voima will fall to about 47 percent from 52 percent.

Last week, the government decided to merge the electricity grids of state-owned Imatran Voima Oy (IVO) and industry-owned Pohjolan Voima into a new company which will operate a nationwide electricity grid.
The UPM-Kymmene statement did not refer to the grid company arrangement.
